title: observability-weekly-2026-05-18
content:
TL;DR:
- Focus this week: finish tracing propagation fix, stabilize new dashboard refresh, and land initial cost telemetry export pipeline.
- Blocking item: high-cardinality dashboard queries causing Grafana refresh timeouts; infra is investigating shard allocation.

Highlights:
- Tracing: Root cause for missing span tags on async job runners identified (context loss in background worker wrapper). Patch landed in staging; metrics improved 30% in end-to-end trace completeness.
- Dashboards: New latency heatmap for p99 per-route is in prod behind feature flag; initial feedback positive but one heavy query needs rollup.
- Cost telemetry: Prototype exporter for per-route token cost to BigQuery is ingesting sample data; early numbers show two endpoints (chat-moderation and summarize-batch) account for ~42% of hosted inference cost.

Tracing (owner: Marco Ruiz):
- What we worked on:
  - Fixed context propagation in async-worker v2 wrapper. PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/432.
  - Added span tests (unit + integration) to catch regressions for background tasks.
  - Adjusted sampling: dynamic sampling by service + route to keep trace volume stable while preserving tail traces.
- Metrics/results:
  - Trace completeness increased from ~68% -> ~89% for batch-worker pipelines in staging.
  - Average trace size up ~12% (more spans recorded) but disk retention unchanged due to sampling policy.
- Follow-ups:
  - Deploy propagation fix to Dedicated canary on Mon 2026-05-19. (Marco)
  - Update OTLP exporter to tag customer_id earlier in pipeline to simplify billing joins. (Lin)

Dashboards (owner: Lin Chen):
- What we worked on:
  - Deployed latency heatmap (p50/p90/p99) behind ff.
  - Investigated slow dashboard refresh: culprit is a high-cardinality label in the per-route traces panel causing long Elasticsearch/Grafana queries.
  - Implemented a pre-aggregation job prototype to generate 5m rollups for heavy panels.
- Metrics/results:
  - Heatmap refresh time ~600ms for most routes; heavy route queries still occasionally timeout (~8% of refreshes).
- Follow-ups:
  - Rollout rollup job to prod for top-10 heavy routes (Lin / infra).
  - Add dashboard-level fallback: show last successful snapshot if live query fails.

Cost telemetry (owner: Samira Khan):
- What we worked on:
  - Completed first end-to-end pipeline: inference -> token-counter -> cost-assigner -> BigQuery.
  - Built a sample dashboard showing per-route cost, normalized by requests and token-count.
- Early findings:
  - summarize-batch (long-context summarization) has a high cost-per-request because average context length is 16k tokens.
  - chat-moderation receives many short requests but high QPS; cost is dominated by volume.
- Actions:
  - Add per-customer cost alerts for teams approaching monthly thresholds (Samira).
  - Work with Product to add a recommended quantization/shorten-template for summarize-batch to reduce tokens.

Standups / daily log (week of 2026-05-12 -> 2026-05-18):
- Mon 2026-05-12: Planning + canary schedule for tracing fix; infra started investigating shard hot spots.
- Tue 2026-05-13: Tracing tests flaked in CI; root cause was a race in test harness, fixed.
- Wed 2026-05-14: Heatmap merged to staging; initial perf tests look good.
- Thu 2026-05-15: Cost exporter began ingesting production sampling stream (1%).
- Fri 2026-05-16: Dashboard timeouts spike observed; rollup prototype created.
- Mon 2026-05-18: Weekly sync; decisions below.

Action items (owner in parens):
- Deploy tracing propagation fix to Dedicated canary (Marco).
- Increase sampling for error traces for 24h to capture regressions (Aisha).
- Roll out rollup job to prod for top-10 heavy panels and monitor (Lin + infra).
- Enable per-route cost alerts in BigQuery views (Samira).
- Short-term: add dashboard snapshot fallback to reduce user-facing errors (Lin).

Blockers / Risks:
- Grafana query timeouts causing false negatives in on-call paging — need immediate mitigation (snapshot fallback) before full rollup rollouts.
- Cost telemetry is sampling at 1% currently; accuracy for low-volume routes is low. Need to decide on targeted increased sampling for select routes.
- Dedicated deployment SLA soon; we must validate tracing fix across GPU-backed nodes (different worker binary).

Requests for other teams:
- Infra: prioritize investigating shard allocation for metrics storage; provide ETA for shard rebalance.
- Product/PM: confirm list of 5 routes to prioritize for cost mitigation experiments.
- Support: flag any customers seeing dashboard timeouts this week and provide request IDs.

Next week priorities:
- Stabilize dashboards (rollups + fallback).
- Validate tracing fix across Dedicated + Private.
- Finalize cost-alert thresholds and start pilot with two internal product teams.

Notes / Misc:
- Meeting links: Weekly observability sync (recurring), notes saved to Confluence page CONFLUENCE-OBS-1234.
- Next sync: 2026-05-25 (weekly).
